root_cause: composePortalProjectionLayers replaces the entire legacy portal object whenever a canonical Brain layer includes its own portal object. A tenant AI model preference and activation request saved to legacy tenant storage can therefore disappear from the composed authoritative server view despite a successful write.
prevention_rule: Compose the portal namespace at top level, retaining legacy-only tenant keys such as aiModelPreferences and aiModelActivationRequest while preserving explicit canonical precedence for duplicate keys. Test both precedence and re-read by the activation gateway. No provider activation or signed proof can be derived from restored preferences.
